message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 74.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and system developer. I want to become a Information Technology Auditor. My family can afford at most about USD 6700 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Management and system developer roles

explanation:
This program is highly recommended because it offers the best job prospects among all options, boasting a 90% placement rate and a high median starting salary of $17361. Since getting a good job is your top priority, this MBA Technology Management in Delhi provides excellent career potential. The main trade-off here is that its minimum required grade (79%) is significantly higher than your current average of 74.8%, requiring you to demonstrate strong academic performance.

This MSc Information Systems program offers a strong balance between career potential and affordability, with a median starting salary of $15394. The curriculum focuses on business information systems, which aligns well with your interest in IT Management and auditing roles. While the tuition ($2400) is moderate compared to some options, it provides excellent job outcomes and is located in Coimbatore.

This MBA Technology Management program is an ideal fit because its minimum grade requirement (74%) perfectly matches your academic average. Furthermore, it has a very low annual tuition of $1250, making it highly budget-friendly while still offering solid job prospects with an 81% placement rate and a median salary of $13142. The trade-off is that its starting salary is not the highest available.

If budget is a major concern, this MSc IT Management program in Hyderabad is unmatched due to its extremely low annual tuition of only $1000. It also has a very accessible minimum grade requirement (62%). While the median starting salary ($11249) is lower than other options, it provides a reliable entry point into IT management without straining your family's budget.

This MBA Business Analytics program is recommended because it meets your location preference by being situated in Delhi and has a manageable tuition fee of $1450. The focus on business information systems aligns with management goals, and the minimum grade requirement (60%) is very low. The main trade-off is that its salary potential ($10648) is among the lower end of this shortlist.
